points.title: 学术生涯起点
points.description: 欧几里得出生于古希腊的亚历山大城，这里成为了他学术生涯的起点。他在这里接受了教育，并最终成为了一名数学家。欧几里得在亚历山大城的学术氛围中成长，受到了当时著名的学者和哲学家的启发。
points.descriptionEn: Born in the ancient Greek city of Alexandria, Euclid began his academic career here. He received his education in this city and eventually became a mathematician. Euclid grew up in the academic atmosphere of Alexandria, inspired by the famous scholars and philosophers of the time.

points.title: 撰写《几何原本》
points.description: 欧几里得在亚历山大城撰写了著名的数学著作《几何原本》。这部著作是数学史上最重要的作品之一，对后世数学的发展产生了深远的影响。它系统地总结了古希腊的几何学知识，并建立了几何学的公理化体系。
points.descriptionEn: In Alexandria, Euclid wrote the famous mathematical work 'Elements', which is one of the most important works in the history of mathematics and had a profound impact on the development of mathematics. It systematically summarized the geometric knowledge of ancient Greece and established the axiomatic system of geometry.

points.title: 数学教育改革者
points.description: 欧几里得在亚历山大城不仅是数学家，还是一位杰出的数学教育家。他通过《几何原本》这部著作，对数学教育进行了改革，使得几何学成为了一门严谨的学科。他的教学方法对后世产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: In Alexandria, Euclid was not only a mathematician but also an outstanding mathematical educator. Through his work 'Elements', he reformed mathematical education, making geometry a rigorous discipline. His teaching methods had a profound impact on later generations.

supporter.zh: 欧几里得被誉为古希腊最伟大的数学家之一，他的《几何原本》是数学史上的一部里程碑式著作，对后世数学的发展产生了深远的影响。他被认为是数学教育的改革者，他的教学方法至今仍被广泛采用。
supporter.en: Euclid is hailed as one of the greatest mathematicians of ancient Greece, and his 'Elements' is a milestone in the history of mathematics, profoundly influencing the development of mathematics. He is considered a reformer of mathematical education, and his teaching methods are still widely used today.

critic.zh: 尽管欧几里得的《几何原本》对数学的发展做出了巨大贡献，但其公理化体系也存在一定的局限性。此外，他的数学思想在一定程度上限制了后世的数学发展。
critic.en: Although Euclid's 'Elements' made a great contribution to the development of mathematics, its axiomatic system also has certain limitations. Moreover, his mathematical ideas to some extent limited the development of mathematics in later generations.

objective.zh: 欧几里得是古希腊数学的集大成者，他的《几何原本》不仅是数学史上的经典之作，也是西方文化的重要组成部分。他的数学思想和方法对后世产生了深远的影响，至今仍被广泛研究和应用。
objective.en: Euclid was the master of ancient Greek mathematics, and his 'Elements' is not only a classic in the history of mathematics but also an important part of Western culture. His mathematical thoughts and methods have had a profound impact on later generations and are still widely studied and applied today.

self.zh: 数学是上帝用来书写宇宙的语言。
self.en: Mathematics is the language with which God wrote the universe.

others.zh: 欧几里得是数学的化身，他的《几何原本》是数学的圣经。
others.en: Euclid is the embodiment of mathematics, and his 'Elements' is the Bible of mathematics.
